scope: Planning judgments for the mapped selected-package procedures; not new compilation or numerical verification.

next_candidates.title: BFGS without a supplied gradient
next_candidates.reason: Existing driver supplies analytic derivatives; finite-difference fallback is a distinct unverified configuration.
next_candidates.oracle: Use translated positive-definite quadratics and Rosenbrock problems with known minima; independently evaluate final objective and gradient and require successful solver status.
next_candidates.precautions: Do not register the gradient callback. Reuse comparable problems from the analytic-gradient driver, with tolerances suitable for numerical differentiation; do not infer a speed ranking.

next_candidates.title: Nonlinear least squares without a supplied Jacobian
next_candidates.reason: Existing driver supplies the residual Jacobian; automatic differencing needs its own checked configuration.
next_candidates.oracle: Reuse the independently checked exact exponential family and explicit step factor 1 from the analytic-Jacobian consumer, without supplying its Jacobian. Independently recompute parameters, residual norms and stationarity.
next_candidates.precautions: Do not register the residual-Jacobian callback. Retained default-step and nonzero-residual probes already fail even with analytic Jacobians: see docs/gams-candidates/nonlin-least-squares/README.md. Do not broaden this candidate into a general noisy-fit claim or accept convergence status without a correct answer.

next_candidates.title: Signed real cube roots
next_candidates.reason: The existing consumer checks sinc and sech, leaving this separately mapped procedure unchecked.
next_candidates.oracle: Use signed exact dyadic cubes, zero, and independently generated high-precision noncube references over a bounded normal range; check finite values, signs and scaled reconstruction.
next_candidates.precautions: Call the real cube-root API directly; establish the supported kind first. Exclude overflow and subnormals unless independently checked.

next_candidates.title: Modified Bessel I0
next_candidates.reason: The existing special-function driver covers beta, not the separately mapped Bessel function.
next_candidates.oracle: Compare besi0 with high-precision modified-Bessel references confirmed at two precisions; include zero, signed values, parity and arguments on both sides of implementation branch boundaries.
next_candidates.precautions: Inspect the pinned fixed-form implementation for precision and valid range. Do not reuse the package beta implementation as a reference or claim unscaled overflow behavior.

next_candidates.title: Integration of tabulated data
next_candidates.reason: The checked procedure record currently has a quadratic-root driver; tabulated integration is a different public capability.
next_candidates.oracle: Derive exact area from the documented piecewise interpolation rule; test affine data, irregular grids, partial intervals and the supported integration-limit conventions.
next_candidates.precautions: Use the catalog's pinned upstream lib_array fixes. Review the actual integral convention before assigning a more specific H2 subclass; do not demand exact integration of arbitrary nonlinear data.

next_candidates.title: Interpolation of tabulated data
next_candidates.reason: A distinct mapped public API currently demonstrated only in the ordinary catalog main.
next_candidates.oracle: Use irregular knots and independently computed segment weights, exact knot values and the documented endpoint/outside-range behavior.
next_candidates.precautions: Confirm construction and evaluation semantics in the staged, upstream-patched source. Refine the GAMS subclass only after confirming the interpolant; avoid copying the existing ordinary smoke check alone.

fortran-lapack-eigh.action: Existing high-level eigensystem probes already fail at the hosted file-size linking limit. Investigate link footprint/selective linking before another attempt. The separately checked lower-level syev driver does not verify this high-level API.

fortran-lapack-svd.action: Existing high-level SVD probes already fail at the hosted file-size linking limit. Investigate link footprint/selective linking before another attempt. The separately checked lower-level gesvd driver does not verify this high-level API.

forpca-pca.action: Keep the wrong-variance reproducer. Recheck an upstream repair or separately reviewed mode; do not reduce assertions to direction-only checks and call PCA variances verified.

twopnt-solve.action: Retest the manufactured full-profile and residual assertions after a source-supported upstream repair; solver success status alone is insufficient.

fortran-test-helper-create-r64-array.action: Retest requested bounds after an upstream change; do not accept the observed out-of-range values as a uniform [0,1) driver.

friction-fit.action: Resolve the retained double-subtraction diagnosis before repeating the same manufactured fit.

friction-internal-state.action: This record names private interpolation/fitting callbacks. The public LuGre integration API already has a checked driver; review or split the mapping before designing another consumer.

heatflow-evolution.action: Inspect simulate and its file/output requirements, then test a bounded manufactured full evolution with profiles and conservation. The separately checked sparse-solver heat example does not verify this application.

fortran-simplify-perpendicular.action: Preserve the repeated-call endpoint and radial-filter failures. Require an independently checked geometric error bound after a repair; the ordinary single-call example is not a general fix.

coretran-neighbor.action: Retain the valid 31-point failing query; repeat full brute-force nearest-neighbor checks after a repair rather than promote the small ordinary smoke test.

m-draw-raster.action: Adapt the existing PPM example into a dedicated driver with parsed dimensions, complete pixel-range checks and independently predictable line/rectangle geometry. Headless output only; avoid unsupported font-dependent drivers.

easy-plplot-png.action: Reuse the headless author-style plotting setup, then add independent source-data/axis checks and artifact validation. A nonempty PNG alone is not mathematical verification.

ogpf-contour.action: Adapt the Gaussian contour example with explicit expected grid samples and headless artifact checks. Do not infer contour accuracy from file existence alone.

plplot-demo-api.action: Adapt the pinned author API with controlled geometry and output inspection, retaining native-library and device qualifications. Existing preview verification is ordinary-demo evidence, not a dedicated GAMS proof.

gtk-fortran-demo-api.action: Keep Cairo image surfaces without GUI initialization; use known geometry and parsed output/status checks. Widgets and event loops remain outside the online sandbox scope.

stdlib-pca.action: Highest class-coverage payoff (L13b). Investigate whether a smaller selective link fits the existing file-size limit before another full driver attempt; the failed link established no numerical result.

stdlib-activation-gelu-gradient.action: Retest the independent differentiated references after an upstream fix; value-only GELU drivers do not cover this derivative.

stdlib-activation-silu-gradient.action: Retest the independent derivative references after an upstream fix; value-only SiLU drivers do not cover this derivative.

stdlib-complex-underdetermined-fits.action: Retest the exact wide COMPLEX128 LSTSQ call after resolving the retained size error. A successful pseudoinverse solve is a separate API, not verification of LSTSQ.

quadrature-fortran-2d-rectangles.action: Diagnose the retained nested-callback runtime crash before repeating the polynomial suite; distinguish callback/toolchain/sandbox behavior from numerical integration error.

quadrature-fortran-3d-rectangles.action: Diagnose the retained nested-callback runtime crash before repeating the polynomial suite; existing one-dimensional success does not validate nested integration.

roots-fortran-toms748-bracketed.action: Investigate the direct-object status/overflow failure and convenience-wrapper crash separately; correct roots with failed status do not satisfy the checked-driver contract.

orderpack-order-statistics.action: Resolve the small-n orderloc counterexample first. orderval and orderval_special were not reached on that failing case; they may be reviewed and tested as separate APIs without claiming orderloc is fixed.

specfunc-fullerton-upper-incomplete-gamm.action: The positive-x path already has a separate checked driver. Keep the full-domain x=0 failure and retest that boundary after a repair; do not add another positive-x duplicate.

specfunc-fullerton-entire-hyperbolic-int.action: Resolve the signed Cinh counterexample before claiming full-domain accuracy; the public inverse_chi name does not mean inverse-function evaluation.

forlab-median-percentiles.action: Diagnose the first n=1 median crash. Percentile-only testing could be a separately reviewed consumer because the failed combined probe did not reach it.

forlab-difference-cumsum.action: The difference-only API already has a checked driver. Resolve or clarify cumsum's sorting behavior before claiming ordered prefix sums; do not add another diff duplicate.

class_claim_reviews.rng-uniform: Existing golden-stream driver already checks seed/jump behavior. Review whether to expose that proof under L6c before writing a duplicate; cached-normal reseeding remains a separate retained failure.
class_claim_reviews.bspline-fortran-3d-mixed-partials: Existing driver constructs the interpolant and checks values as well as derivatives. Review E2a versus E3a2 presentation before duplicating the same experiment.
class_claim_reviews.bspline-fortran-4d-mixed-partials: Existing driver constructs the interpolant and checks values as well as derivatives. Review E2a versus E3a2 presentation before duplicating the same experiment.
class_claim_reviews.lookup-interpolation: The E3 service consumer already checks interpolated values. A new E1a driver should demonstrate a distinct construction/interpolation problem; otherwise review cross-class presentation.
class_claim_reviews.bstrith-operations: The N2 consumer already contains independently checked additions/subtractions. Review the arithmetic scope of A1 before adding duplicate arithmetic assertions.
class_claim_reviews.spatial-neighbors: The N5 consumer already compares 3D nearest/radius searches against brute force. Review P discovery classification versus demonstrated geometry before proposing the same search again.
class_claim_reviews.gslib-api: Existing L13 driver checks ordinary kriging systems and covariance. Review E2 interpolation scope and classification; a new driver should add a distinct spatial interpolation problem.
class_claim_reviews.formal-divergence: H1 divergence/gradient success is not a time-dependent PDE solution. Split volume-integration and PDE claims; I2 needs a real evolution/boundary problem, not relabeling the operator test.
class_claim_reviews.friction-internal-state: Do not confuse private fitting callbacks with the separately checked public state-integration API.
